system.description:
A rule-breaker who survives by luck, deception, tech, and perfect timing.

Loaded Dice: At the start of each session, roll d12s equal to your subclass Power trait. Spend a Loaded Die on an action roll to swap one Duality Die value with the Loaded Die value. Clear unspent Loaded Dice at session end.

Cheap Tricks: When an adversary moves into Very Close range, mark a Stress to force a Reaction Roll against 10 + your level. On a failure, the target is temporarily Weakened or Vulnerable.

Hope Feature - Cheat Fate: Spend 3 Hope after an action roll to reroll one or both Duality Dice.

Class Items: A pair of loaded dice or a signal scrambler.
backgroundQuestions: Who taught you your first trick, and what betrayal made you stop trusting them?
What system or law did you learn to bend so well that it became second nature?
What is the one rule you swore you would never break, and how close are you to crossing it?
connections: You once covered for me when a scheme went sideways. What did it cost you?
I slipped you an edge at the perfect moment. What was it, and why do you still carry it?
You know the one secret that could ruin me. Why have you not used it against me?
